description: This file contains internal definitions, macros, and function declarations for big number (bignum) operations in cryptography, specifically related to the BN (Big Number) library used in OpenSSL. It includes macros for multiplication, squaring, and window size calculations for modular exponentiation, as well as function prototypes for various multiplication and comparison routines.

methods.description: Macro to determine the window size for modular exponentiation based on exponent bit length.
